observed.caption: A vibrant covered market stall displays colorful beaded necklaces, earring boards, and patterned garments under a corrugated metal roof.
observed.description: A densely packed market stall under a corrugated metal roof displays numerous colorful items. On the left and center, clusters of beaded necklaces in gold, black, blue, orange, yellow, red, brown and multicolor hang from hooks and a horizontal rack, including large circular collar necklaces near the top. In the foreground center, two wooden-framed boards with red backing are covered with dozens of hanging earrings in various colors and shapes. On the right, long patterned garments and dresses with swirl and elephant prints hang from a rack, with large fabric shoulder bags in orange, brown and pink geometric patterns hanging in front. A person with dark hair and dark clothing is partially visible standing behind the central necklace rack, facing away from the camera. Daylight enters from the open sides and roof gaps, illuminating the concrete floor where a red and white striped sack rests near the garment rack.
